Cheerful.name: Cheerful
Cheerful.description:
😄 You find the bright side and share it.

🌱 Your smile and steady voice keep frightened people calm and help crowds follow directions.
⚠️ The smile hides your own bad days, and the cracks show when you are alone or exhausted.
⚠️ Some people read cheer as not taking things seriously, so your warnings can be brushed off.
🔀 If you are also Cynical, the cheer is real and runs on low expectations.

📈 Grants: Evacuation +5
Cheerful.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is upbeat: they joke, encourage, point out what went right and keep spirits up. In an emergency their friendly voice and steady smile help crowds stay calm and follow directions. Weakness: they hide their own pain behind it, and the narrator may show the cracks when they are alone or exhausted. Some people read cheer as not taking things seriously, so a warning from them can be brushed off, and a joke in a grave moment can land badly. If the character is also Cynical, the cheer is real and runs on low expectations: they smile because they never expected much. The narrator may hint at what the smile covers; the player decides when the character lets it drop and who sees it.
